title: Biased flip probability and derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The probability, under the product distribution with bias parameter $p$, that flipping coordinate $i$ changes $f$ equals the mean under that same distribution of the square of the discrete derivative of the real-valued sign function associated to $f$ in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
